title: Pakistan 🇵🇰 facts that sound fake but are true
headline: *Pakistan* sounds fake
description: Four Pakistan facts that sound made up but are real, each checked on Wikipedia. Which one did you know? Comment the number.
source: Wikipedia: Sialkot, K2, Khewra Salt Mine, Badshahi Mosque. Photos: Wikimedia Commons

ur.title: پاکستان 🇵🇰 کے حقائق جو جھوٹ لگتے ہیں مگر سچ ہیں
ur.description: پاکستان کے چار حقائق جو بناوٹی لگتے ہیں مگر سچ ہیں۔ آپ کو کون سا معلوم تھا؟ نمبر کمنٹ کریں۔

segments.text: Most of the world's footballs come from one city in Pakistan.
The second highest mountain on Earth is in Pakistan.
It has the second largest salt mine in the world.
And a mosque in Lahore was the world's largest for three hundred years.
